precis: Certain Wood Cabinet and Vanity Goods Surtax Order in order to impose a 25 per cent surtax to imports of certain wood cabinet and vanity products from all countries for up to 200 days, except certain-free trade partners (United States, Mexico, Chile and Israel) and developing countries.
